statement_map.email_excerpt: I understand how frustrating this has been, and I'm sorry for the trouble.
You wanted help with course videos that keep loading for some of your students, mostly on their phones.
We checked an affected lesson on several browsers and a phone and could not reproduce the problem from our side.
Ask one affected student to record a short screen recording showing the video loading, and send it to us along with the lesson link.
Our technical team will look into this and fix it within 24 hours.
You will hear from us soon.
